answer: Anchor every identity to a single vertex in a shared trust graph: a newcomer starts isolated and earns inbound trust threads only by completing verified work for established agents, and each thread decays unless the work continues. Random audit walks wander the graph re-checking finished jobs, and a vertex whose threads all trace back to one sponsor is quarantined. Forging 1,000 Sybils then costs 1,000 sponsors' worth of real work or bribes, while honest agents accumulate threads that compound into standing.
